list_detail() pairs a searchable list with a side detail inspector. Click any row below to inspect its structured facts. { "type": "list_detail", "title": "Registered Agents", "search": true, "columns": [ {"key": "name", "label": "Agent"}, {"key": "status", "label": "Status"} ], "rows": [ {"id": "1", "name": "Support Bot", "status": "Active", "detail": {"Model": "gpt-4o-mini", "Latency": "94 ms", "Tools": "docs_search, create_ticket"}}, {"id": "2", "name": "Code Reviewer", "status": "Active", "detail": {"Model": "claude-3.7-sonnet", "Latency": "210 ms", "Tools": "git_diff, run_tests"}}, {"id": "3", "name": "Release Manager", "status": "Idle", "detail": {"Model": "gpt-4o", "Latency": "140 ms", "Tools": "check_ci, trigger_release"}} ] }

Parameter Type Description rows list[dict] Row objects with id, column values, and optional detail key-value dict. columns list Column names or {key, label, align} definitions. title, search, page_size, empty options Panel label, search box toggle, page size (default 25), and empty state message.
